Greetings Officer!
Season 4 introduces 2 new Divisions featuring new Units, Upgrades, Commander Abilities, Cosmetic Packs and new playstyles. We're also introducing 'Commander License', a way to help new players to ease into the Eximius RTS experience better. Other addition includes a new Impossible difficulty, updated lighting in all levels, an all-new AXR soundtrack and some updates to Homeland Security. 

Full patch notes below!

[GAMEPLAY]

 Added GSF Commando Division
 Added AXR Pioneer Division
 In-game chat will now only display player’s Callsign instead of player’s account name
 Commanders now automatically enters RTS view at the start of every match
 Added East Asia Servers


[COMMANDER LICENSE]

 Commander License is a requirement for new players to play as Commanders (RTS) in Online play
 Commander License can be earned by reaching Rank 10
 Returning players with Medals from Season 1 ~ 3 will automatically be granted the Commander License
 AI Commander will take over Commander role in games if there are players with no Commander License


[IMPOSSIBLE DIFFICULTY]

 Added new Impossible Difficulty for Team Skirmish and Offline Play
 AI will control all resource and victory points and have all research and tech unlocked at the start of the game


[LIGHTING]

 Updated Morning, Noon, Clear, Twilight and Cloudy lighting
 Improved visibility on all lighting and reduced shadow intensity to prevent players and units from hiding in darker areas
 Updated textures for some darker mesh to respond better to the new lighting


[CO-OP MISSIONS]
Homeland Security

 Increased Brutal Difficulty and introduced new enemy type and waves (Good Luck)
 Slightly expanded the play area around the North SAM site


Urban Hustle

 Fixed player being able to get permanently stuck inside a dumpster


[COSMETIC PACK]

 Added a total of 10 new Cosmetic Pack for AXR and GSF
 Players can now preview skins on other Units and Battlesuits in the Store
 Replaced Eden Core currency icon


[SOUNDTRACK]

 Added AXR Soundtrack. AXR Soundtrack will only play when playing as AXR


[LOCALISATION]

 Added Japanese Localisation
 Updated Chinese, German & Russian text


[MISC]

 Changed Anti-Aliasing quality setting to Anti-Aliasing method instead
 Replaced ‘Hunker Down’ Squad Command to ‘Hold Position’
 Updated Intel page to reflect latest changes on all units, structures and vehicles
 Removed Retreat Buff Icon on Support Crawler when Shield is deployed
 Added new overencumbered buff icon for Aegis when Shield ability is used
 Weapon Crew members will now stand behind the machine gun or mortar when deployed
 Fixed Scout upgraded icon not displaying for players who joined a game later
 Fixed AI Infantry units not reloading when their gun magazines are empty
 Fixed M34 Flamethrower flames not following the correct direction
 Fixed laser pointers on Gauntlet CPC and G12 not being centered when switching from RTS view to FPS view
 Fixed Elite Marine prioritising using hand grenades after receiving Equipment Upgrade
 Fixed Covert Vanguard ‘Execute’ ability not killing the target
 Improved vehicle stability while reversing
 Fixed Armory Turret continuing to fire at a dead or destroyed target
 Fixed AXR Structures being able to un-deploy when affected by EMP
 Fixed Main Menu buttons being partially cropped at resolution above 1920x1080


[KNOWN ISSUE]

 In Quick Play, East Asia Servers are labeled incorrectly as Auto

notes.title: Eximius 1.1.9 Hotfix - 5th January 2023
notes.content:
Greetings officers,

Our first hotfix of the year of 2023. A quick patch to address some of the recent issues in season 3.

Few main highlights include fixing the payment methods on Epic Games Store, making the DLC now purchase-able. The server browser filters has also been added.

New Feature
Added Filters for Game Session / Lobby ID, Settings and Sorts in Server Browser

 Pre-Game Lobby now shows the Lobby ID after the Lobby Name
 In-game Menu now shows the Lobby ID / Session ID, player can share this to their friends to allow them to search
 Remove limits for searching lobbies (previously was 50)
 Show some additional settings in the server browser, such as Victory Points, Annihilation and Death Match
 Added unequip skin button to customization skin menu to reset skins to default.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/43108ca88bb68e921906fd92544d649e39ae847d.png

Improvements

 Capped main menu frame rate to 60fps. Previously may cause frames overdrive, causing GPU to overwork.
 Changed the default crouch key to Ctrl (instead of C)


Balance Change

 Support crawler's spawning of Ironguard changed slightly. They will now start spawning only when deployed for the first time. When Service Ironguard is killed, they will start a spawn countdown to spawn the next one, but only when the Crawler is deployed. This will prevent the service ironguard to spawn while the crawler is on the move. 


Bug Fixes

 Fixed Issue with Eden core unable to be purchased in the store.
 Fixed graphical glitch on Covert Vanguard's stealth wall in Twilight lighting.
 Fixed graphical glitch when deploying scanner-type abilities by Commander. It used to make things hard to see while scanner is active.
 Fixed issue with Bio-Injector texture showing as grid.
 Fixed scope sights glitch which causes sights to be blurry
 Fixed issue with bus disappearing in Town Square map
 Fixed a glitch that causes the APC to not play it's deploy animation. 
 Fixed issue with Power plant that reduces energy gained when building a new power plant
 Fixed issue with Resource tooltip not showing correct number
 Fixed issue with Search Bar text can be overflowed and extended indefinitely
 Fixed issue with Epic Games Store DLC entitlements
 Fixed issue with ATR Firespear where it no longer spawns lingering fire on the ground
 Fixed issue with Specialist Strike Squad where they can't be control-group selected
 Fixed issue with AI Commander spamming weapon crew senselessly.
 Fixed issue with Skirmish AI will no longer deploys mortar on location that has sky occluded.
 Fixed issue with Viper's claw when hooks an officer will permanently get stunned if Viper moves behind a wall

notes.title: Season 3 Breakthrough Out Now!
notes.content:
Greetings Fellow Officers,

A new season has begun and with that new additions, improvements and tons of changes that is sure to change up your play style. We are also Introducing a new Premium store with brand new Premium cosmetics so do check them out as well.

Enjoy the update and welcome to Eximius Season 3 Breakthrough!
Refer below for the full patch notes.

Eximius is now running on Unreal Engine 5!
With this bring the new Lumen lighting and Vehicle Physics Improvements! Here are some Screenshot preview with the new Lighting. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ef63e5f9a793c58b27f9567f26664410c623b0cc.png

New Features

 RTS Key override Settings
Players are now able to change their key input for all units and all commands based on their own preference 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/e4365f994c12fc99d5de679fa676f548fcc6e764.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/cc262f8c81ddcd465b07c61b576aa2c79a7b3adb.png

 Pop-Up Turret function for Locked down armory and mules
When a resource point has been secured by an armory or Mule players are able to mount a pop up turret on it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/2d9b8e07c6af12ef76be8aeee4a40ef9c6ff565a.png

GSF Pop-Up Turret 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/72ddb74ffa96b5024f3337355b1a4273d70d2a70.png

AXR Pop-up Turret
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/1188e16ffc05846d96ce6995bd807cad084e950f.png

 Added 7 new Season 3 challenges medals


Support Crawler Revamp

 AXR Robotics Division has now gained a new Support Crawler NV unit
Support Crawler NV is able to spawn service Ironguard but with a max limit of 2. If one is destroyed another will spawn in after a short delay and if the crawler is destroyed all Service Ironguards attached to that crawler will be destroyed as well. 

Support Crawler NV is also able to launch a scarab shield. Activate the ability on the crawler and launch it at a location in an AOE. All Ironguard in the radius will gain a scarab armor protection that provides them with additional 1 off shield for 60 seconds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/b82ab7d8a5d4b067d64c925b3a85b6c9148b7ab6.png

 AXR Energy Division receives Support Crawler SV-2 Unit
When deployed Support Crawler SV-2 will generate a dome shield that protects its allies inside it. Support Crawler SV-2 also has a shield health that will regenerate after not taking damage for a certain amount of time. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/9a535e7fc5551f68908113c40976713ae6dacdfc.png

 AXR Stealth Division receives Support Crawler PV Unit
Support Armament Crawler Stealth able to and spawn scout projections at a targeted area around it when its deployed. It is also able to deploy 3 mines which will be ejected from its back. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/135e36debdb62405d55efc33013060b88ab1b6a3.png


Battlesuit Balance Changes

 Covert Vanguard is now able to deploy stealth wall at a stationary position instead of carrying it around
 Aegis shield reduced from 150% to 130%
 Assault Vanguard "CAMG Homing" rocket damage increased by 30% from 500 to 650
 Assault vanguard "CAMG Homing" cooldown increased by 30% from 6 seconds to 7.8 seconds
 Exploit Vanguard now will siphon a fixed amount of resource


Artillery Strike Commander Ability Changes

 Armor General will not have Artillery Strike Commander Ability but now will be replaced with the ‘Bombing Run’ ability


Specialist Revamp

 Specialist production cost reduced from 650/150/0 to 650/100/0
 Specialist will now require Tier 3 upgraded research module to be built, where before they will only need a Tier 2 research module to be built.

Specialist are now able to upgrade to:

 AMPAW package upgrade (AMPAW + EMP) with the ability Throw AEG Grenade command has 50 seconds cooldown
Or
 Tactical Package upgrade with a flashbang attachment that will fire a mini flashbang every 1.5 seconds when in combat and coupled with a Ballistic Damage reduction buff
 Specialist are now immune to flash

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/007a42ca2de894134665b6c1063290fa850df874.png

Specialist Strike Team revamp

 Energy Specialist Strike Team is able to fire a single target laser that splits and splashes to other nearby units within its range
 AXR Stealth Division's Specialist Strike Team will have a strafing run type of ability (Flash Cluster) that players can use in a straight like. Ability will consists of 2 parts (Firing a row of flashbangs first then firing cluster grenades in a straight line). Firing method is similar to MLRS and will equip MRPG when using this ability.


Resource Point Depreciation

 Energy Capture Point resource change from 2 Credits, 5 Energy and 0 Supply to 0 Credits, 5 Energy and 0 Supply

  The story so far  
HARBGRS  (Hivemind Automation for Recycling, Building-maintenance, Governance, Repairs and Sanitation) nick-named Harbinger-systems , was once an experimental AI that services entire metropolitan. The core purpose was a massive system that brings to life wide array of machinery and resources to function on a single purpose of maintaining city-wide infrastructures. 

When these futuristic cities fell to the anarchists, the AI lost control of their primary directive.
In a bid to gain balance in the chaos, it's sub-system evolved violent means to sanitize the city of all major lifeforms. It is unknown what new directives it has given itself.

The rogue AI has now taken over Axeron assets and has integrated biological warfare components to its arsenal of weapons. With the use of powerful hallucinogens, it has created an army that blurs the line between what's real and what's not. These abominations now march across the lands. They must be stopped at all cost.

 Overloaded Ocular Defense : Increases damage dealt

Axeron Stealth Division

 Advanced Specialist’s cloaking module duration is increased by 30 seconds compared to the regular Specialist cloaking module.


General Faction Balance Changes

 Sigma Charged Shot is now an one-off use ability that has area effect explosion radiating through walls.
 Sigma Ocular Charged Shot is now a single-use ability that deals a large area-of-effect damage. It is now unlockable in MCU through research
 All railgun-type weapons will now bypass APS capabilities, currently affecting Sigma and Guardian Troopers.
 M34 Hellspawn's flamethrower won't be intercepted by APS now

 Added ability to Engineer & Scouts to defuse mines

 Increased healing beacon heal radius from 4m to 8m
 Increased healing beacon heal amount from 50 per second to 100 per second

 Reduced the fire delay before GSF Cyclone fires significantly 
 Increased Reserved munition range to 90m from 50m for M33
 M33's Rocket Turret's AOE now has falloff of 1.0 exponent

 Reduced M33's turret turning speed 
 Knight Ironguard cost change to 800/650 from 800/800

 Specialist cost reduced to 800/200 from 800/250

 Service Ironguard cost increased to 1200/200 from 1200/0 
 Echelon crew cost increased to 2400/400 from 2000/300
 Phalanx crew cost increased to 2400/250 from 1800/250 
 AXR vehicles now have a flat 24 seconds build time instead of 30 seconds. 
 Crawler cost readjusted to 2600/900 from 2000/1200
 IFV cost readjusted to 3200/1000 from 3500/1500
 Marine Combat Armor will no longer reduce damage from incendiary, armor piercing and slugs. 
 AXR Sigma charged shot is now able to target ground

 GSF APC energy cost reduced from 1500 to 1000

 Recon grenades are now available. A throwable scanning grenade that marks enemy units through obstacles for the duration of the equipment’s time alive.

Critical hits & damages multipliers

 Bullets fired from players will now pierce through characters' limbs when detecting critical hits. This means the hands and arms no longer block shots supposed to land at the body. This resolves the issue where characters’ limbs would block critical shots to the body, inconsistently dropping the critical hits to non-critical hits for Battlesuits with larger arms like Berserker.
 Critical hit multipliers are now revamped for all weapons.
 By default, the multiplier for body shots and headshots is now x2 and x3 respectively. This was x3 and x5.
 Assault rifles ( XM13 and SiGAR ) body shots and headshots are now x2 and x3.5.
 Shotgun body shots and headshots are now x2 and x2. 
 Light machine body shots and headshots are now x1.5 and x2.
 In line with these new changes. We recognize that the damage is more consistent but dropped lower. Therefore, all bullet base weapons damage values have now been re-adjusted, matching them closer to the old time-to-kill.


General Weapon Changes

 Added heavy weapon movement penalty to all equipment 
 ISW and Warthog clip size reduce to 120 from 150
 ISW starting clip reduced to 4 from 6.
 Warthog starting clip reduced to 4 from 5.
 Warthog firing speed increase to 11.1 shots per second ( up from 10 )
 AXR XM13 SpecOps , recoil adjusted, time between burst reduce to 0.24 ( down from 0.3 )

 Players can fire a stronger shot that deals AOE EMP and Shocks robotics Infantry by consuming 25% of the charge bar. 
 Clip Size Has been increased to 12 from 4
 Max ammo has been increased to 48 from 24

 Hyperion Maelstrom will now deal 10000 total damage to vehicles (400 per seconds/ total 25 seconds)

 Added a new segment in the tutorial range to teach players how to buy and upgrade weapons from Mules and Armory
 Players will now be given a completion prompt after “Completing Mission Objective Training” that redirects them to an option of their choice that could either be Return to the main menu to start a game, continue to RTS tutorial videos or continue challenge dome training.

Players can then set up their medals in the customization section and it will be shown in the main menu, Setup Lobby and the enemy death cam. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/4134276d22f8edd0a2b64f062d6e283aa30df72a.jpg
Contracts will reward players based on the difficulty of the task given. Daily contracts will always have an easy, medium and hard contract while weekly will have a much more difficult contract. Contracts are only available on online matches and will not be recorded if it's an offline match.

 Added New RTS cursor

 Ironguard now has proper animation when it's moving faster. 
 Ironguard Knight now sprints when out of combat or not shooting, moving at 6m/second. 
 Strategic map (M-key map) is now much brighter and has more contrast. Allowing you to see the details of the map.
 Improved movement behavior and physics for all AXR structure transports, they are much less likely to get stuck while deploying outside of base.
 AI Cannot see new units behind the Soft Cover but can track targets that are already visible.

 Added Continue to next game function after the game has ended in the post game screen.
 Open Game Now Accepts Preferred Faction Type Upon Joining

 Drag Select will now select a Structure if nothing else is in the selection box

 Proximity mine and resupply crates will now show its icon in RTS view
 Friendly resupply crate will now show on strategic map
 Deployed Power reactor will now auto lock a nearby resource point when the resource point is  recaptured. Instead of undeploying and deploying again to lock the resource point. 
 Every infantry will now perform an avoid animation when be targeted or being shot at by Officer
 New SFX for CPC and ATR
 Added SFX for CPC charging related
 Added SFX when purchasing weapons from the armory

notes.title: Season 2 'Nemesis' - 2 Days
notes.content:
Faction Change & Improvement
One of the core focus of Season 2 is about making all units, technology and division relevant. We took a look at some of the overused and underused unit and gave it a fresh change.
Much of these changes involve adding and enhancing abilities of unit. We wanted to balance the choice of the game by adding to the weak instead of taking from the strong. 

Let's take a look at the changes.

Here are some of the it : 

Elite Marine Equipment
In season 2, we're revamping the randomized equipment of Elite Marine. Giving more control to GSF commanders, the weapon choice is now an upgrade choice.  Elite marines will now start with the light machinegun but will have the choice to replace it's weapon to ATR or Grenade Launcher.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/54994ed64498db63cb96ed5537ba6e780602c78c.gif

Iron Guard Knight
Next we take a look at the Knight variant of the IronGuard. In season 2, they now have improved speed and can sprint when not in combat. Additionally , the protocol upgrades have been merged for Rooks and Knights and do not require a separate upgrade. This means upon unlocking Robotics computing unit, the knight variant is immediately available.

Laser knights on the other hand receive a special Overload ability. This ability allow them to continuously fire their weapon without reloading at the cost of moderate damage over the duration of the overload.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/7f6ddb89ee989b7c944f2fad114b3605d828333a.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/0675ba16fc7de9b0de73bd296eaa3bf97193f705.gif

Ocular Bombardment
The Ocular Defense (Turret) now gain access to an upgrade, which allow the turret to fire light artillery at target location. This requires the Energy Division commander to be at tier 3.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/345becb1c37b90e56c46376ca195dc31b42dfa06.gif

Vehicle's Ability
Most of the vehicle's ability has now been revamped. Sigma charged shot can now fire at obstacle and deal a heavy splash behind it. This shot is powerful enough to instantly kill marines and regular light infantry behind obstacles. One additional note here on Sigma is that, the regular weapon will now cut through APS. This is applicable to all type of railgun-type weapon, which affects Sigma and Guardian troopers.

Sigma Ocular's charged shot now summons a singularity charge at a target, exploding into a violent blast, damaging all types of units in a target area including structures and vehicles.

All GSF's vehicle now received reserved munition upgrade. IFV and APC has a temporary armor-piercing rounds. M34 Hellspawn has super napalm strike. MLRS will not automatically receive EMP warhead ability when reserved munition is upgraded. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c0112e943a1acc359f6dd74eade047dbe00689fd.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/52540a665a8b787e01d56307d5ddc5afa88cf711.gif

Recon Grenade
Let's take a look at the Recon grenade. This grenade that is available to both faction will scan and mark unit in it's effective range until the grenade expires. It's a useful addition since players no longer highlight enemy silhouette behind walls.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/2926d130a70c5181e6cadcb922029ceba39ce205.gif

Starting Unit 
One significant change to early opening strategies is that, free units will now spawn at a starting barracks and fabricator the first time they are built. GSF Barracks receive 10 marines while fabricator receives 2 ironguard. This will reward players who go barracks first while punish greedy commanders that skip barracks to focus entirely on economy.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/f315a410893a13738e9040d8194fe51d86f4d539.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/19fc0f3331f04f0cece29e2dd45f6f8355925ab0.gif

These are only a handful of improvement and changes coming in Season 2 'Nemesis'. Catch the full changelog when the update is launched.

Discuss with fellow officers on how you'd use this changes to it's full potential at our Official Community
 AmmoboxStudios discord

Self Destructible Battlesuit Pods
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/a44c5872c49865eba8da3f02c65630e2325f53e5.gif

After the recent Zenzo Tournament, we engaged with top level players and community members on some critical balance issue of this map, mostly being the Resource & Victory Points being favored to South team. Changing these locations also creates more dynamic play in certain part of the map and reducing dead zones. We've also added elevated defensible high ground for North side of the base as well. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/067326a3bb7dae82f8e5978ce6ab07fe70b2db90.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/e1f75a923b6136f193bc8bff41cd39213d25d4c9.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/79f9913be02aa0f8f6dadc0f5c025b50a0dba7df.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/b8b436752f9675c5823f4f1d0f08fa5b9f765a13.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/7e71f5b919e89349a63d8709f1209f0c4fd7eb41.jpg 

UI/UX Improvements
Today's update also includes 3 major UI/UX improvements. 
[olist]
 Highly requested Toggle mode for sprint , crouch and aim down sight (ADS) has been implemented. This can be turned on/off in Settings->Controls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ac0b6221abd73af94f07e706320047df482a1123.png
 Armory improvements has been added. You can now drag/drop your Primary Weapons and swap their slots. This addresses a huge issue highlighted by the community that sometimes weapons slots will be swapped after getting into a Battlesuit.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/6d4af3d6b8b7d707e141e71016b61a393811c9f4.gif
 On the RTS side, to prevent button clutter, some Unit Commands will only appear when Units of the same group is selected. This helps the buttons to stay in a more predictable position.
[/olist]

Community Driven Fixes

On the area of fixes, we would like to highlight the Suggestion Bot that we've recently created to help us sort through the community's ideas. This bot will gather your suggestion and organize them in a discord bot, allowing developers to sift through and separate salty complains and constructive suggestions. But rest assured, they're all weighted similarly for considerations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/32732744b6ff236263a8bcd9adc34ad6573eb541.jpg
One example is a recent suggestion was to give the Officers the ability to have your Squad defend an area. This has been implemented through a Hunker-Down Squad Command. Using this Command allows you to get your Squad to temporary not follow you, while defending the area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/9da6c795ffbb393349f52e81d89a89283fc32ac0.png

If you would like to be part of the discussion, everyone is welcomed. Remember to head on to our Discord

Minor Upgrades to AI Commander
We are continuously making improvements to the Commander AI. We noted some blind spots that made the AI performed in a less than ideal manner. Now, AXR AI Commanders will now lockdown resource points and GSF AI Commanders will now upgrade Power Plants when possible. Some improvements were also made in regards to the Build Order. Expect them to perform better. 

Balance Changes
3 Major balance changes are coming into play. 

Emergency Shield Pack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ae5c3ee9b99e47904c856efbe1425383e3b9d55f.gif
The most contentious equipment in the 'Zenzo Eternal' tournament has been bought to highlight. While we want to maintain a special position of this equipment, the Emergency Shield Pack (ESP) has been deemed too valuable even with the increased cost. 

Adjustment has been made after some discussion with community. With this new update, the ESP has been tuned to half the use duration and most importantly, at the end of use, the user will be without a shield for 5 seconds. This effectively means that ESP can only be used at the edge of the frontline where you're 3-4 seconds away from a safe friendly area. If you over-extend, you will still be punished if an enemy chases you down while your ESP is on. After this change, we will continue to assess to see if the ESP remains in good position.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/4a26b55fcc1e5f2e370973806c14c49e8063904f.gif

IronGuard Knight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/4ab6b544fac10386c9b454bf81d7a28d7fdfe0e7.gif
Knight Ironguard is going through an improvement as well. As per discussion with community, it is deemed that Knight is still in a less than ideal position as a Tier 3 infantry. In this update, we decided to give it a stronger anti-armor role. When targeting enemy Vehicles/Structures, Knight will fire a single powerful Anti-Armor shot. This secondary shot is automatically used without any additional actions needed. 

Take note that despite this, Laser Knight is still significantly better in dealing with enemy Armor

Scout vs Marines
This has been a longstanding issue of whether Scouts are better than Marines in many situations. Despite having more HP and higher DPS, marines has constantly been defeated by the same number of scouts. We have found that the issue is in the engagement range. Having the advantage of firing first means the Scout can often flinch the Marine before their weapon can be drawn. This causes a further delay before Marines can return fire.
We have now increased the Marines engagement range to be similar to Scouts. However, despite this Scouts may still have a slight advantage at longer distance due to better weapon spread.

 Ace Vanguard changes 
Another longstanding issue since launch. Many players have used Ace Vanguard Eagle Strike to illegally access many supposedly inaccessible areas. This has caused many issues like collision glitches, exiting the map and creating other unfair advantages. We tried blocking access to those areas, but it ended up being too much work and we couldn't beat the 'creative' power of gamers.  

In this update, Ace Vanguard Eagle Striking into an illegal area will perform a return flight to the original location. Apart from this, nothing else will change. Illegal areas are defined as areas that cannot be accessed by a regular infantry.

Hello Officers,

Here's the first update for the 1.0 version of the game! You can find multiple balance changes, UI/UX improvements and bugs and crash fixes. Thanks for sending us the suggestions and the crash reports as they help us to take the necessary steps to improve the overall 'Eximius' experience. For the 1st round, we'll be supporting Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and German. We're looking into supporting other languages if we see that there's a demand for it.

Many credits to the community who reported, assisted and discussed the issues with us.

notes.title: [ Final ] Launch Countdown + Customizations
notes.content:
We're few hours away from 1.0 Launch.

In this round of showcase, we will be presenting the customization and cosmetic system that is newly implemented. This will serve as part of player progressions. Unlock skin packs with in-game currency and level them up when playing and completing online matches. As you level up the pack tiers, more cosmetic items will be available such as callsigns, banner, and frames. The skin itself will also increase in complexity. You can also buy your way through these tiers with in-game currency.

[previewyoutube=Z8-UcXwbzJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

These are some notes on how the cosmetic items work :

  Skin packs :  Individual cosmetic pack , unique to each faction. Can only be unlocked with in-game currency. After unlocking, it can be upgraded up to 8 times. Each upgrade will provide an additional item. Skin packs can be upgraded as you win matches with the equipped skin or by fast-leveling them with in-game currency known as 'Credits'
  Credits :  Credits can be earned when you level your rank. It is used to purchase new skin packs and to fast-level them. 
  Player Skins:  These replaces the texture material on the character, each pack contain up to 3 tier. At the highest tier, your assigned squad members will also receive the skins, allowing you to have a full squad with the skin. 
  Player Frames :  These are the frames that display your callsign in-game. Like the skins, they also have tiers that can be unlocked.
  Team Banners :  These are commander selected only cosmetic. By choosing a banner, your base and surrounding areas will be decorated with these banner. Show the enemy who is in town.
  Callsigns  :  Your player character will be identified as these callsigns in-game. They are unique to per-faction and is one of the item unlocked in the skin packs. These callsign will also have an individual representation on the minimap.  Unlike the Early Access version, callsigns can now have customized frames , hence you can mix and match them.
   Rank :  Represent your rank this season. As you play more matches, you will rank up. Each game earns you experience(XP). Victory gives you higher XP than loses. As you rank up, you gain Credit. Rank will be reset each season but not your stats.

notes.title: Eximius 1.0 Full Release Content Summary
notes.content:
The countdown Begins

For the next 7 days until the launch, we will be publishing one content video a day for each of the item below. In the meantime here's the summary on what's coming.

Let us know in the comment below what you think and what you're looking forward to play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/16b28268ab444b3a0663c245aeca48ad0ea270e6.jpg

Battlesuits
Battlesuits are powerful suits that can be called down by players at the cost of weapon credits. Wearing these suits will grant players abilities that can change the tides of battle. We increased the amount of Battlesuits from 4 to 8 for the 1.0 launch. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/f8c0304d4035fe959a0e6ad874e76bc30c415526.jpg
Battlesuit Lineup

On top of that, these Battlesuits now have Passive abilities in addition of their 2 Active ones. The Passive abilities will compliment the roles of the Battlesuit further while making each and every one more unique to play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/3883129dbdc3b30b7bc79f0fecf619a27e76ce55.png
Passive Abilities

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/40584395193fc3ea07f61bde7d399d730225cd0b.gif
Orion's Sleight of Feet in action

Faction Divisions & New Units
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/51822d85a0c98b2c893e7c61dedbe59ad840da06.jpg
The 6 Faction Divisions of Eximius

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/463b02202e7b4d42a38668e14a628a7352dca5ae.png
New Unit Lineups 

This is a big one. The entire unit roster of Eximius has been more than doubled now. With the introduction of this new feature, Each faction will be sub-divided into 3 division. 

These divisions have different capabilities; ranging from new units, new technologies to new Commander Abilities. Each offering a different playstyle of your choice. Faction division can be selected during the setup lobby.

We don't want to get too much into detail since this itself will take an entire post. There will be a follow-up video during one of the countdown. Stay tuned to catch the details of the new units, abilities and upgrades.


DBNO
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/79b71a35b6347da2f495c4427893caf047d5e823.jpg

The 'Down But Not Out' (DBNO) mechanic make its way into Eximius. When you're defeated by a player, your teammates has a limited amount of time to bring you back into the battle. 


Asset Remaster & New Units Voicelines
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/749a6f85e68b75b810d08bc74c05e4111203b20d.jpg
Old GSF Units and New GSF Units Lineup

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ac4523c2bbf9513201e382b207ea9583a0625073.jpg
Old and New SIGAR

For those in Early Access, you would recognize the GSF units on the left. Those models were used since our prototype and they have served their purpose as a placeholder. We remastered them along with many of the older assets in Eximius such as buildings and weapons. 

New voice lines are added for all units for both RTS and FPS as well. On the FPS side, units can play different voice cues depending on the context such as "Under Attack" or "Enemy Spotted". Keep an ear out and take advantage of the situation.


New Maps

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/0d89b427c9679ab3ed7b6f70436f03eeaec3b10b.png
Sunday Mall

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/5d4b919fc5a5ea32b9b6110c8c209108a6e2c2e8.jpg
Precious Cargo

Two new maps will be added

First is Sunday Mall, a PVP map centered around large open space of carpark and mall. Get your shopping gear ready as we raid the frontline.

The second one is Precious Cargo, an escort PVE mission. Players will need to protect a moving cargo from enemy raiders and bombers. 

 Environment Remastering 
On top of having new maps. All the current PVP / PVE map has gone through remastering. Lighting, shading , foliage and assets has been remastered and optimized. Below are some examples
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/503a8cf8b57016faf290da75647f7b0339ee3b2a.png
Central

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/476b9af6a55f10b614bfae458f091576980bdd97.jpg
Academy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/a00a5424754408b4895d6e23b7f3f2685cdf0711.jpg
Express

New Techtree

On the Commander side, the entire Techtree has gone through an overhaul. Previously we didn't have a proper tiering system, resulting in all technology unlock being lumped into one or two tech building. With this new system, as you tech up, the tiers are much more distinct.  Each faction will start from Tier 1, and will advance to Tier 2 and then finally in Tier 3, commander will choose to commit their resources into one of the 3 possible Tier 3 branch. This will be applicable to both factions. The picture above shows the three possible branching tech at tier 3. 

Take an example of GSF. After having Armored Logistics in Tier 2, you can choose to upgrade one of the three possible structure into a Tier 3 tech building.

Advanced Barracks - Unlocks Elite Marine & other upgrades
Advanced Armored Logistics - Unlocks Cyclone HWS & other upgrades
Advanced Supply Centre - Unlocks Guardian trooper & other upgrades

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/203b7e4a0a103605ae475afb46c377cd74b17e60.jpg
GSF New Upgradable Buildings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/04f61001415713aebbf904e90ecc3f9aaebf9c97.jpg
AXR New Upgradable Buildings

Reinforcement System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/09a53b2b68e47a654d966915e0b19047165316d1.jpg
Reinforcement Tier 2

A new reinforcement system is introduced for Eximius 1.0. We intend for it to work primarily as an underdog mechanic by giving the losing team a small boost of units. The reinforcement will activate when a team Victory Points drop below a certain threshold. Each team will have 3 charges of Reinforcement. Use this to your advantage!

Customisation, Cosmetics & Progression
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/a17d4604d679a3f9498e8c3f23e20c9dc84b6d33.jpg
Store Page

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c4c7f3fc3346a7b3d143f33a6f455aab84144116.png
Players can personalise their Player Cards by mix and matching their frames and emblems

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/02639bb3fd4924dbced71269fa30bca6bc62b03b.jpg
Costume Battle Pass System. Players can equip and level up their obtained cosmetic pack

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/00bd2f59bdf072d8f57991483040e11d559cac29.jpg
At Level 6, attached Squad Units will receive cosmetics as well.

The customization system has finally been unlocked. A high demand feature that we have been working on for some time. Players can now purchase skin packs from in-game store and level them up. As they level up, more cosmetic options will be unlocked similar to a Battle Pass.  There will be no lootbox or pay-to-win mechanics.

 Complete UI Revamp 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/e78ac08024b3cae2ec73c1e064f55657ebf3be99.jpg

Every single major part of the UI has been revamped. Starting from the main menu all the way the FPS and RTS HUD screens. This is something you definitely won't miss when logging into the game. 


We'll be dropping more additional updates on our social media over the next week leading up to the launch day. Remember to wishlist, & share if you have not.  Community is at discord.gg/ammoboxstudios

Once again, we await you at the frontline.
Signing out.

notes.title: Eximius Spring Update - March 28th 2020

Hello Officers,

We're dropping Eximius 2nd biggest update with our Spring Update. As we inch closer to our 1.0 launch later this year, we're slowly adding features requested by the community and features we think will improve the overall Eximius gameplay experience.

The major highlights in this update is the newly added Contextual Ping. Taking inspiration from other titles like Apex Legends and Rainbow Six: Siege, we hope that having a more robust communication tool will help players coordinate better in Eximius.

We also added Private Lobby for those who prefer to play with their friends (or foes) uninterrupted. Feel free to stream the matches with the available Spectator slots and tools in-game. We plan to add more features such as custom Victory Points.

New and updated weapons are added as well. The ZC9 Handcannon delivers a heavy punch for the AXR faction. We also updated the old trusty GSF S1911 sidekick. New behaviour, model, animation and sound. A new PVP map is added as well. "The Crossing" is more open compare to the other existing maps. We look forward to our PVP battles with the community on this map.

That's all for now. As usual, you can reach us through our Discord channel or the Steam Forums. Send us your suggestion and let us know what you think about the game. Future updates will be even more exciting so do look forward to that.

notes.title: Exploit Vanguard Battlesuit To Get UI Improvements In Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Here's a brief overview of some very nice UI improvements for the Exploit Vanguard Battlesuit that is expected to be included in our next update. Watch the full video further below or catch up on the new improvements in this article.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ffeb584a821d0380f0a013df5c3ced5f1fbb9359.png

The Exploit Vanguard is capable of hacking/disrupting all manner of things. Players can disable a vehicle, hack a resource point and even deplete an enemy officer's shields. While it is certainly useful there are a few drawbacks which we have addressed in this coming update.

[previewyoutube=UaTOVOjZrwE;full][/previewyoutube]

1.) White Range Box & Green Reticle

Previously the Exploit's hacking skill worked with an invisible UI range which made it hard to tell when a hacking connection would break when moving the mouse. Target selection was also based on the highlighted unit instead of the closest target to the player, Now with the White Range Box, players can better see their effective range and the green reticle will highlight hackable targets and will ignore non-hackable targets allowing for more accurate targeting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/d0083fe0e5c542f961aced6f73639637ebcf9af7.jpg

2.) Signal Strength Indicator

The signal strength indicator is found just at the top of the white range box. The icons and bar will change colour from red to green indicating how strong the connection is to allow a hacking sequence. This allows players to know their effective hacking range, so they can tell if they are about to move or look too far away from their target.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/825da026d6423fdd68cb250f98edc46e339ee762.jpg

3.) Green Incognito Icon Timer

This new icon appears after a successful hack has been accomplished. It the target that is being hacked can be disabled, the icon will appear and will gradually drain in color, acting as a timer. This will tell the player how much time they have before the target reverts back to normal. This particular icon will be visible to any other player who is also equipped with an Exploit Vanguard Battlesuit for better coordination.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/1cfe2804cb86d2fa0a9ec3f96794e29dd25a5e39.jpg

This was just one of many more updates to come for our game. Stay tuned for more news as we get closer to the release date. 

See you all on the frontline!

notes.title: Eximius 2019 Development Roadmap
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/17d68955b8701354feddbb35c2acdec0003e2c23.jpg

Greetings Officers,

After weeks of discussion we are finally ready to share our development plans with you. As mentioned before, we plan to have Eximius exiting Early Access phase by Q3 2019. We have a lot of work to do to get there and we would like to invite you to join us throughout our Early Access journey. But first, a recap on Q4 2018. 

Q4 2018

 [strike]Halloween Update[/strike]
 [strike]Comms & Matchmaking Update[/strike]
 Tournament Update
 Faction Update 01


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/2bb8db275236d6df651df173dc90e928b9689d25.jpg

We're pushing out the Tournament Update very soon in conjunction with the first ever Eximius Tournament. We updated the Spectator UI and fixed some Spectator related bug. Downtown, Express and Central maps are also updated with minor changes for the tournament.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/db22953aba0b8e8638eedcf102fce8e71e2bd0f8.jpg

After the Tournament Update, we will release the Faction Update 01. In this update the GSF faction will receive 1 new Unit and 1 new Weapon for the Officers. The AXR faction will receive 2 new Units and 1 new Weapon for the Officers. These new additions should shake up on how games are being played currently.


Q1 2019

 Improvement Cycle
 Tutorial Update
 Equipment Update
 Level Update
 Battlesuit Update
 Social & Progression Update
 War Room Update


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/797a916b0bc5241ad25baf10864226d72c9833bd.jpg

The first thing that we'll do is to allocate some time to improve the game from multiple angles such as the FPS/RTS experience, animation, weapons, battlesuits, UI and other Quality of Life (QoL) improvements. During this period, we invite you to join our community at Discord to talk to us about what changes you would like to see that would help make the game more polished.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/c7a760a5e919b6370b4b2f61cffe2d53bfe6af26.jpg

We also plan to update the existing Tutorial. While it's currently working, we think that a good update will help new and existing players with understanding the game better.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/b768812fee2e45b87959bc8a0ff0fe642fa05c12.jpg

As for the Equipment Update, we are planning to add a grenade equipment. This addition should open up more combat possibilities on both FPS and RTS side. We're thinking of including other equipment such as landmines, portable health/ammo packs but we're still experimenting on our side. Do drop us a comment below if you have any ideas for us. ːsteamhappyː

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/abba10162c04b14cad8e3563a366757479e70cb7.jpg

For the Level Update, 2 new maps will be added to the game. 1 PVP level and 1 PVE level. We'll share more info when the time comes but we think that these 2 will be the best levels yet in Eximius. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/e70fdbcfdf3c8aae53746379e614aff758ad0d60.jpg

With the Battlesuit update we will add 1 new battlesuit for GSF and 1 for AXR. These Battlesuits will add more impactful choices and utilities for both the Commander and Officers. We are also thinking of changing on how the Battlesuit is built and delivered to the Officers. We may let the Officers to call down a Battlesuit of their choice instead of having it being built and sent by the Commander. We'll keep testing it out on our end before changing the delivery system.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/c964bd0fa60427b59580924e4314f5680ac39fc7.jpg

One of the most interesting challenges we will be tackling is the Social and Progression system. The current leveling system in the game is at its infancy and we plan to grow it. We're thinking of introducing Unlockables, things like callsign and banners and eventually (maybe) skins and other doodads that players will enjoy. Customisable player profile will be added as well. You need to look your best when heading out to the frontline.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/a352827f5804e9bcd77f63f73e52dd5e8e4de153.jpg

Finally for Q1 2019, the War Room update. The War Room is planned to replace the existing Planning Lobby (Hangar) where players choose their Commander and tech before the start of a match. We plan to add more interactivity and functionality to help players plan better before the start of a game. For example, showing what level is being played in the War Room will open up discussions on which Victory Points to attack or defend. It will be an exciting update for sure.

Q2 2019

 Faction Update 02
 Battlesuit Update 02
 Level Update 02
 Squad Improvement Update


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/83f13046064983455768c3bae0fcb5a2c1b91a99.jpg

Entering Q2 2019, we'll start with the 2nd Faction Update. More Vehicles and stronger Units will be added into the game. We also plan to include more Vehicle and Weapon upgrades. This update is sure to excite RTS players on the possibilities of creating and combining strategies. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/89060568ae67645ec16b8adaa5ec3892b448519e.jpg

Battlesuit Update 02 will see 2 new Battlesuits being added to the game. 1 for GSF and the other for AXR. By this point, there will be 3 Battlesuit on each faction.We plan to include more Battlesuits after the V1.0 launch as they are an integral part of Eximius.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/25270b642a703ca4dba9913a5fae4f28f1bb1d9f.jpg

2 new levels will be added with the Level Updates 02 update. Again, we'll be adding 1 new PVP and 1 new PVE level. More details will be shared in the future.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/3a67a3c2a0cb841f20caaf3c3fdc66820c950b5c.jpg

Squad Improvement Update will be one of the other interesting challenges we will face. We will be working on updating the AI Squad Experience. Currently, AI units that are attached to Officers have limited capabilities on what they can do. We plan to expand that to allow Officers to execute more complex strategies with the fellow Officers and Commanders.


Q3 2019

 Localisation
 Lore Development


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/65da912a91d83e29580001d543c3ee92134e91d9.jpg

With the core content for V1.0 being completed or close to completion, we can finally begin on localisation work. For fans who are waiting for localisation support, we can only ask for you patience and understanding at the moment. Rest assured, we will work on it when we get there.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/b1e94da97997d898d94f01cbb6f8fda2d4a2691b.jpg

Lore Development is something we are doing throughout Eximius development. Ever wondered why AXR (no, they're not aliens) seems more advanced than GSF or why do the cities look abandoned? We hope to answer these questions and share more background regarding the world of Eximius here.

The team will also be constantly working on bug fixes and updating the game throughout Q3 2019.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

And there you have it, the development plan for Eximius. One thing to note though, things may change throughout the development for Eximius but we plan to stick to it the best we can. We'll be sure to update you should there be any potential changes, with good reasons.

We look forward to your suggestions and feedback throughout the development. Thank You for reading. ːsteamhappyː

Dismissed

notes.title: DEV BLOG #02 - Gearing Up
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/9c336fc3a1a24f13a7ed2d6336883c07a695cff4.jpg

Attention Officers,

“Full speed ahead” is the only acceptable term describing what’s going on in Ammobox Studios. We’ve been very busy lately with setting up the Axeron Faction and putting up the final touches for the BETA. 


BETA Info

We been getting a lot of requests on when is the BETA and how can one get their hands on it. We would like to thank everyone for their interest as well as patience. Internally, we knew that preparation for the BETA will be challenging and time consuming and boy, it really has been. A lot of time is spent on preparing the servers to ensure you get the best online experience possible.

As for when and how to access the BETA, we will announce it within 2 weeks time. Keep your eyes peeled on our social media pages, you don’t want to miss it. In the meantime, please make do with the teaser image above.


Axeron Faction

We are preparing the Axeron faction to be playable for the upcoming BETA as well. This will be an all-new faction with new units, weapons, vehicles and abilities. Commanders that favours guerilla and hit and run tactics will surely find Axeron being their primary choice.

With Omni Balls, Axeron buildings have the unique ability to move and deploy almost everywhere on the battlefield. This mobility will give Axeron Commanders the element of surprise when used properly.

Axeron Building Movement 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NDXKyUPUVfA

Axeron Mule 
Axeron Commander can also deploy the Mule, a mobile armoury providing weapons and supplies to Axeron Officers at the frontline. Players will need to pay extra attention to protect the Mule from enemy fire. While it is agile and nimble, it is not built to take punishment.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZA7PjAHWXRQ
It's quite adorable when you look at it

Axeron Weapons 
Here's also a preview at the arsenal available to Axeron Officers/Players. More heavy firepower to be added after Early Access.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/3c5a9a213e42c399f96ca9ecda85bc80c1bb51e8.jpg

We will share more Axeron gameplay content over the next few weeks. For the time being, you can check our social media channels for new Axeron updates.


Homeland Security (Co-Op Map)

We also have been developing a new Co-Op Map titled ‘Homeland Security’. The main objective is to survive against waves of enemies looking to destroy your base. You can squad up with 4 other friends while taking on this mission.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/704cf218615a519b87425f2bdce2ab7c2459d1a8.png


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/2c37294bac349d73d3196a22ef2c273ccb0fbec0.png


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/6d6593d12806b245a7731719d4ea2cd1f1ce63a7.png


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/fa4187f3103603eedd5b00ffd05ca3fc664128f7.png


We also plan to add dynamic objectives to make every playthrough a unique and exciting one. We might be streaming this level on our weekly developer livestream sometime this week. Come join us and let us know what do you think about this level. We can’t wait to hear your feedback and response from this Co-Op experience.


Quality of Life Improvements
Other than the major updates above, we also have been making some minor improvements in terms of gameplay and quality of life. You can check out the updated armoury in the video below. We will be actively gathering usability data from users when the BETA period begins. With this data, we hope to improve the game better.

https://youtu.be/Uet31goNSnA


That’s all for now. Look forward to the BETA announcement very soon. Till next time.

Dismissed.

notes.title: DEV BLOG #1
notes.content:
Attention Officers,

Summer is approaching and it’s getting livelier by the minute at Ammobox Studios. The team is working hard on preparing the upcoming BETA build of the game that is scheduled to go LIVE sometime in between July and August. 

In the meantime, you may have notice that we are getting chattier on our social media. We realised that we haven’t been communicating with you - our community as frequently as we should have. We are taking steps to improve that. We are grateful and thankful for your continuous support over the years.

This Dev Blog will serve as a communication channel to our community. We intend to share more behind the scenes information, the talented team working on the game and other shenanigans. We hope you enjoy the read and welcome you to join us on this exciting adventure.

So what’s been going on over the past few weeks? We had some European and South American publishers testing out the game. They gave some valuable feedback in the process which will help us in improving the game. Eximius was also featured in Alienware roadshows in Singapore. A custom single-player survival mode was created just for Alienware. You can check it out here.  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mdyr2Yd6Gl8

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/f004851e6ac75ee64051781f24721365df266259.jpg
 Glorious 4K Resolution 


On a side note, Eximius will be playable in Singapore this coming weekend at Asia Game Festival. (https://asiagamefest.com/)  Our friends from Matchroom will be showcasing the game. (https://www.matchroom.net/) It’ll be the improved version of the survival-oriented ‘Alienware Build’. If you are attending Asia Game Festival this weekend, do check out the game at booth AGF-C09. There are prizes to be won and complimentary BETA keys to be given away. Give us a shout-out if you happen to be there.

We also had the opportunity to meet up with Chris Murphy, an Evangelist for Epic Games. He was in the region giving some talks on Getting Started with Unreal Engine and Technical Art and VFX with UE4. For the young and budding game developers out there who wants to learn more, you can check out his course at Udemy. (https://www.udemy.com/unreale4/)  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/6c29b6822d796fd379f59e82b6b09d58c8c089b6.jpg
 Serious Conversation All Around 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/9656227e059ea723461371d2c532f6b82c42f2fe.jpg
 Big Swag, Happy Man 


On the development side, you may have notice that we have started showing some upcoming Axeron Contents and a new level titled 'Express City'. We'll be playtesting Express City regularly over the next few weeks. There are some balance and fun issues with it now but we are confident we can iron out those kinks soon.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/d0b346d9af1fc1e7cbffadf7fa13fd131535ca25.png
 First Pass. Better Look, Coming Soon


That’s all for now. We plan to include more art and tech related content in our next dev blog post. As usual, you can keep in touch with us through our social media channels or comment away below. We’ll be here to answer. Till next time.

Dismissed.
